title: Create Your Personal Brand Kit
description: Build a complete personal brand identity from scratch — define your brand voice, create visual assets, optimize your LinkedIn, set up a personal website, and audit your online presence across platforms.
prerequisites: Basic understanding of personal branding concepts from notes
A clear idea of your niche/specialization in digital marketing
learning_outcomes: Define a clear brand archetype and voice for yourself
Create professional visual identity assets using Canva
Optimize a LinkedIn profile for discoverability and credibility
Build a simple personal website or portfolio page
Conduct a cross-platform brand consistency audit

steps.title: Define Your Brand Voice and Archetype
steps.instructions:
1. Choose your Brand Archetype (pick ONE that fits your personality):
   - The Sage — You educate and share knowledge (good for teachers, consultants)
   - The Creator — You make things and inspire creativity (good for designers, content creators)
   - The Hero — You overcome challenges and motivate others (good for career coaches, fitness)
   - The Explorer — You try new things and share discoveries (good for tech reviewers, travel)
   - The Everyman — You are relatable and practical (good for down-to-earth advice)

2. Define your Brand Voice using this template:
   - I am: [3 adjectives] — e.g., 'Practical, Friendly, Curious'
   - I am NOT: [3 adjectives] — e.g., 'Formal, Boring, Aggressive'
   - I talk like: [describe] — e.g., 'A senior batchmate giving career advice over chai'
   - My topics: [3-5 content pillars] — e.g., 'AI Tools, Career Tips, Marketing Basics'

3. Write your Brand Positioning Statement:
   'For [target audience] who want to [goal], I am the [your role] who [your unique value] because [your credibility].'
   Example: 'For marketing freshers who want to land their first job, I am the AI-savvy content creator who simplifies complex strategies because I learn and share in real-time.'

4. Save this as a one-page document titled 'My Brand Voice Guide'.

5. Use ChatGPT to generate 5 sample social media posts in your defined voice. Check if they sound like you. Refine the voice description if needed.

steps.title: Design Your Visual Identity in Canva
steps.instructions:
1. Open Canva (canva.com) and create a Brand Kit (free plan allows 1 kit):

2. Choose your Brand Colors (pick 3):
   - Primary color: Your main color (used most often)
   - Secondary color: Supporting color for accents
   - Neutral: For backgrounds and text
   - Use coolors.co to generate a harmonious palette
   - Tip: Look at Indian brands you admire for color inspiration

3. Choose your Fonts (pick 2):
   - Heading font: Bold, eye-catching (e.g., Poppins, Montserrat)
   - Body font: Clean, readable (e.g., Inter, Open Sans)

4. Create these assets in Canva:
   - Profile Picture: 800x800px — professional photo with a subtle colored border or background
   - LinkedIn Banner: 1584x396px — your name, tagline, and 2-3 things you do
   - YouTube Banner: 2560x1440px — channel name, content type, upload schedule
   - Instagram Highlight Covers: 1080x1080px — create 5 icons (About, Tips, Tools, Projects, Contact)
   - Content Template: 1080x1080px — a reusable template for Instagram posts with your brand fonts and colors

5. Download all assets in PNG format. Create a folder called 'Brand_Assets' and organize them.

6. Save the Canva links so you can edit later (do not delete the designs).

steps.title: Optimize Your LinkedIn Profile
steps.instructions:
1. Open LinkedIn on desktop (desktop gives full editing access).

2. Upload your new profile photo and banner (created in Step 2).

3. Optimize each section:

   HEADLINE (220 characters max):
   Formula: Role + Value + Keywords
   Example: 'Digital Marketing Student at TechPath Academy | Learning SEO, Social Media & AI Tools | Sharing my journey from zero to pro'

   ABOUT SECTION (2600 characters max):
   Structure:
   - Line 1: Bold hook or question (e.g., 'What if you could learn digital marketing in public?')
   - Paragraph 1: Your story (who you are, where you are from, why marketing)
   - Paragraph 2: What you are learning/doing (skills, tools, projects)
   - Paragraph 3: What you offer (how you can help others)
   - Last line: CTA (e.g., 'Connect with me to exchange marketing ideas.')

   FEATURED SECTION:
   - Add a link to your personal website (or Carrd page)
   - Add your best LinkedIn post (once you start posting)

   EXPERIENCE:
   - Add 'Digital Marketing Student' at TechPath Academy
   - Add any internships, volunteer work, or freelance projects
   - Even 'Social Media Manager for College Fest' counts

   SKILLS:
   - Add at least 15 skills: Digital Marketing, SEO, Social Media Marketing, Content Writing, Canva, ChatGPT, Google Analytics, Copywriting, Email Marketing, Graphic Design, Video Editing, Market Research, Brand Strategy, Data Analysis, Communication

4. Set your profile to 'Open to Work' (if applicable) or 'Providing Services'.

5. Send connection requests to 10 classmates with a personalized note.

steps.title: Set Up Your Personal Website
steps.instructions:
1. Choose a platform (pick ONE based on your comfort level):
   - Carrd.co (easiest — one-page site, free plan) — recommended for beginners
   - GitHub Pages (free, good for HTML practice) — use the landing page template from this module
   - WordPress.com (free plan — more sections, blog support)
   - Notion + Super.so (turns Notion page into a website)

2. For Carrd (recommended for speed):
   - Sign up at carrd.co
   - Choose a minimal template
   - Add sections: Hero (name + tagline), About, Skills, Projects, Contact
   - Use your brand colors and fonts
   - Add links to LinkedIn and YouTube
   - Publish (free plan gives you a yourname.carrd.co URL)

3. For GitHub Pages (recommended for practice):
   - Use the HTML landing page template from code-landing-page-template.html
   - Customize the content with YOUR information (name, city, services, etc.)
   - Replace the placeholder text with your personal brand copy
   - Push to GitHub and enable Pages in repository settings
   - Your site will be live at yourusername.github.io

4. Minimum content for your site:
   - Your name and professional title
   - A 2-3 line bio
   - Services you offer (or plan to offer)
   - At least 1 project or case study (can be from this course)
   - Contact information or a form
   - Links to your social profiles

5. Test your website on mobile (responsive check). Share the link with a classmate for feedback.

6. Add the website URL to your LinkedIn profile (Website section and Featured section).

steps.title: Cross-Platform Brand Audit
steps.instructions:
1. Open all your profiles side by side (or take screenshots):
   - LinkedIn
   - YouTube
   - Instagram (if using for professional purposes)
   - Personal Website
   - GitHub
   - Any other platform you use

2. Check these consistency factors across ALL platforms:

   VISUAL CONSISTENCY:
   - [ ] Same or similar profile photo on all platforms
   - [ ] Brand colors visible in banners/covers
   - [ ] Same fonts used in graphics

   MESSAGE CONSISTENCY:
   - [ ] Same name or handle (or close variations)
   - [ ] Bio/headline tells the same core story
   - [ ] Same target audience addressed
   - [ ] Same content pillars mentioned

   CONTACT CONSISTENCY:
   - [ ] Same email address linked
   - [ ] Cross-links between platforms (LinkedIn links to YouTube, YouTube links to LinkedIn, etc.)
   - [ ] Website links to all social profiles

3. Google yourself: Search your name in quotes (e.g., 'Priya Sharma digital marketing Bhopal'). Document what appears on the first page.

4. Create a Brand Audit Scorecard:
   - Visual Consistency: __/10
   - Message Consistency: __/10
   - Discoverability (Google results): __/10
   - Cross-linking: __/10
   - Overall impression: __/10

5. Write an action plan: List 5 specific improvements you will make in the next week based on your audit findings.

6. Submit: All screenshots, the completed audit scorecard, and your action plan.
